channel.title: Space Needed Updates
channel.description: Stable releases of Space Needed for macOS.

item.description:
A little less clutter, a little more breathing room!
This update brings new cleanup sources to help you reclaim even more space:
- **Applications:** remove apps you no longer need. - **Android virtual devices:** clear out unused virtual devices. - **Go caches:** free up space left behind by your Go projects.
You can now choose what SpaceNeeded scans, browse results as they arrive, and find items more easily with tidier groups and improved search.
We’ve also polished the interface, made cleanup progress clearer, and fixed a few bumps along the way for a smoother experience.

# Space Needed 1.0.0
Initial public release of Space Needed for macOS.
